posted_materials.submission_timeframe_notes: "However, a patient may request consideration for Financial Assistance at any time following discharge or the date of service. Nuvance will evaluate a patient’s eligibility under this Policy as requested at any time, including during the collections and judgment phase."
posted_materials.inconsistency_notes: Policy says 400% FPL and below get fully discounted care, application has typical discounts for each FPL.
posted_materials.languages_available: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin, Haitian Creole, Arabic, Albanian
posted_materials.other_materials_notes: ASSETS: "Hospitals will not scrutinize or take an individual’s assets (i.e., other than the current forms of income described in II(B) below) into account in rendering a decision regarding the availability of Financial Assistance where prohibited by state law."
